result.keyword: What's the best accounting software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses in Australia, I'd recommend **Xero** as the best all-round accounting software.

However, the best choice depends on your business size, whether you have employees, how you manage invoices, and whether you need inventory or payroll.

Here are the options I'd shortlist.

## Best accounting software compared

![Free High-Quality xero logo png for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9qnwxOObu7ODCnjvtZS3OrO0aEo-O6ZxoDMA_BgXWHmpclDvIBWhiiFc7sv2CSwP8u7lVkQexj-2Q6JwX6bLCkmQGBaOEFUaRc4WBhsOFHNZO-ImlbOxfjscA06CBlmqvsyW9qGAz0ywS1dS_FiB_uxDnV6_EbbsbiPoLuJHAA6MH09EB8jLexW7FAqo1iFu?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero**

(Best overall)

- Excellent invoicing and bank reconciliation
- GST, BAS and payroll functionality
- Large network of Australian accountants
- Integrates with many business apps
  
  From approximately \$37/month.
  
  [Xero website](https://www.xero.com/au/)

---

![MYOB - Features, Reviews & Pricing (February 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RSnJXDEAckMg49Z3Uyl1ySpGe5Mf5xY-fiHvWrkutyMlRVsk_cizHWnHbb0_8J0spngX92NOecbYb0xtPztOW_1U5_j589rcfR6e_7DzDwZO-F8qM8BNDHiplH9bI1r3qal9-SnHWVHGyS5SP06Y1atDJc1eUMWI1ht7KCGJtRhy8le1UHOPMDyYDZIt-Ehu?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. MYOB**

(Best for payroll and inventory)

- Strong Australian tax and payroll features
- Good inventory and stock management options
- Useful for established businesses
  
  Business Lite from approximately \$35/month.
  
  [MYOB website](https://www.myob.com/au)

---

![Quickbooks Online — Columbus Business Consulting](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/z_-lMr1rk7nVCnHpykvHbFlLn1azsDdLq1E5IPLLHaY_8oSNYyauUS0LtpVtMtsr7aGmH36ThTapoKB2Ph5Q3eMVc_UXwvW966z4ZTJF_6xHgqWw4BiwFU5MO1xbGE5oY_mXKemXduz1fPiAwGEyT1jt_IjAl-f9situ1bcy769twmRe-HD-uB1wI8CWqiLV?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. QuickBooks**

(Best for simplicity)

- Straightforward bookkeeping
- Good invoicing and expense tracking
- Useful financial reporting
  
  From approximately \$33/month.
  
  [QuickBooks website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/au/)

---

![Zoho Books Logo PNG Vector (SVG) Free Download](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/4BiXY_WEN49lYCvbGaKDFfpQRd4AylQLrJUAqECUlizaJxfPoT7vHE_aMf89Ai5XDgiicM083l1mRaYjiwKVUSU-hyO3RMNhHn9n_1p9iDfGlD90vd7yixEZXe3uN-cFk5rC7bm4cnrvTfOD__DTiLg0FqR-qg85e1e4wDVsY_7IdvAZqwAqO3vtJfa4QIvd?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zoho Books**

(Best budget option)

- Good invoicing and expense management
- Useful automation
- Free plan available for eligible businesses
- Australian payroll generally requires another solution
  
  [Zoho Books website](https://www.zoho.com/au/books/)

Indicative Australian pricing as at November 2026. Plans, limits and promotional offers vary. [australiansmallbusiness.com.au](https://australiansmallbusiness.com.au/software/best-accounting-software-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[bestsmallbusinessaccountingsoftware.com](https://bestsmallbusinessaccountingsoftware.com/blog/best-accounting-software-australia.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarehq.com.au](https://www.softwarehq.com.au/guides/accounting-cost-comparison?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

I'd start by looking at Xero unless you have a particular reason to choose MYOB or another platform. The ability to share access with your accountant and connect other business applications makes it a strong long-term option.
